column1: Amazon aims to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, which means as part
of Amazon’s commitment to The Climate Pledge, we are working to make Amazon
devices more sustainable, from how we make them to how customers use them.
We complete life cycle assessments to help us understand the environmental
impact of each device type and use these learnings to set goals, from using
recycled materials to investing in renewable energy. We are building a future in
which customers will be able to control their smart homes or read, listen, and
watch on their devices, knowing that Amazon is reducing its carbon footprint.
